sections.heading: Overview

sections.content: Under the Council Capital works programme 2026--2027, funding was allocated to improve road conditions along Mileham Street, Church Street & Pecks Road. All investigation and detailed design works were completed and included in these tender documents.
sections.heading: Project goals

sections.content: Scope of works to be read in conjunction with detailed design drawings for Mileham Street drawings (No. 26006D01 to 26006D08), Church Street drawings (No. 26007D01 to 26007D13) and Pecks Road drawings (No. 94862: E:1 to 94862: E:13). Tenderers need to carefully go through design drawings, BOQ/ Schedule of Rates and other documents provided with the RFT document. If any items that are supposed to be included but not appearing in the BOQ/ Schedule of Rates, the Tenderer needs to follow drawings and include such missing items in their price schedule to be submitted with the Tender. In addition to the information given in design drawings and BOQ/ Schedule of Rates items, following scope of works and other mutually explanatory documents, that are provided as attachments to the RFT, must be carefully referred and followed for tender submission.
